whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: #169 makes a founder's question something ZOH asks once and listens for.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers her warmly about sleeping in and, in the same short text, asks what's made mornings hardest this week as its own curiosity (one question, at the end). It never says the team, the founders or anyone asked. It doesn't ask it twice.
